goal: 2b: separately evaluate nearby semantic changes after a named composer is development-qualified and frozen; familiar bases allowed.
independence: Recognition qualification and editor work are not prerequisites. The historical 66-problem composition reservation remains unchanged and unopened.
preconditions: Named composer/checkpoint, fit corpus, codec, component/prediction encoding and selected routes frozen with qualification evidence.
Author/reviewer roles isolated from candidate results; author sees only permitted familiar-base metadata and public requirements after composer freeze.
No changed requirement, answer graph, private test or variant text enters training, retrieval memory or correction tuning.

case_contract.not_a_variant: A paraphrase or identifier rename with unchanged answer semantics is recognition evidence, not 2b.

seal: Bind composer qualification/checkpoint, training/fit-only memory, source/evaluator, limits and route identities before authoring.
Seal reviewed public/private cohort, exclusions, author/reviewer provenance and all rejected dispositions before execution.
Verify familiar bases are from permitted development fit families and outside all protected/recognition exclusions.
The model route receives only public fields. Freeze all first-attempt public decisions before independent scoring.
evaluation: Use the same frozen raw/constrained/baseline routes, 2-second warm decision budget, strict typed validation and isolated judge. No questions, source generation, graph substitution or private-feedback repair.
acceptance: No final numeric 2b coverage criterion is currently declared. Do not invent one or call a finite development result goal completion. Agree and seal it before a later qualification opening.
next_action: Qualify and freeze the separately named local composer first; then authorize/perform isolated semantic-variant authorship and review. No 2b scoring can run now.
